editorial:
Imagine a tiny, crazy squirrel who will do absolutely anything to get his hands on a single acorn. That is exactly what you get here. You follow Scrat, the funniest part of the Ice Age world, as he accidentally finds a time machine. Instead of using it for science, he uses it to chase his favorite nut through different eras of history. The vibe is pure chaos in the best way possible. It is a short, punchy ride that does not take itself too seriously, making it a perfect pick for a quick laugh when you just want to turn your brain off and enjoy some slapstick humor.

What really works is the fast pacing and the clever ways the animators use different time periods for gags. While there is no dialogue, the physical comedy tells you everything you need to know. It is a short film, so it does not overstay its welcome, though some might find the randomness a bit much. You should definitely watch this with your kids or anyone who likes goofy cartoons.
endingExplained: After jumping through several different time periods and causing a lot of trouble, Scrat finally thinks he has his acorn for good. However, in a classic twist, his obsession leads to one final disaster. He ends up accidentally breaking the time machine or triggering a chain reaction that leaves him empty-handed once again. He finishes exactly where he started, proving that no matter how much technology he has, that acorn is simply out of his reach.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly animals and quick laughs.
